INVESTIGATIONS OF BACTERIAL VAGINOSIS
Investigations
- Homogeneous milky discharge with pH > 4.5 (pH > 6.0 highly suggestive)
- Wet mount of the discharge – clue cells (normal vaginal epithelial cells
studded with bacteria, giving the cells a granular appearance)
- Whi fftest - addition of several drops of 10% KOH to a sample of vaginal
discharge (Fishy odour is indicative of a positive test)
